item.title: 360's Zhou Hongyi Says Its Sovereign AI Operating System Is Already in Use at Some Organizations
item.description: 360 founder Zhou Hongyi says the company's sovereign AI operating system, covering compute, models, knowledge bases and an agent factory under customer control, is now used by some organizations.

item.title: Qwen Go! Adds My Apps, Letting Users Build Shareable Apps by Description With Alibaba Cloud Meoo
item.description: Qwen Go! now lets users build long-lasting, shareable apps just by describing them. The My Apps feature runs on Alibaba Cloud's Meoo, which handles building, databases and deployment.

item.title: iFLYTEK Open Platform Launches Agent OS, APA and XFYUN CLI for 700-Plus AI Capabilities
item.description: At its 1024 developer festival, iFLYTEK's open platform launched Agent OS for enterprise agent teamwork, APA for recorded workflow skills, the XFYUN CLI and a TaaS platform for business use.

item.title: Shaoxin Laboratory Builds a Pilot Line for 2D Semiconductor Chips, Due by End of 2027
item.description: A lab set up by Shaoxing and Fudan University is building a pilot line for 2D semiconductor chips on molybdenum disulfide wafers, with its own PDK and EDA tools and open foundry services planned.

item.title: Fudan's RoboSkill Lets Robot Agents Save What They Learn as Reusable Text-and-Code Skills
item.description: Fudan researchers built RoboSkill, which turns methods a robot agent discovers into reusable text-and-code skills and adds touch sensing, cutting task time sharply in simulation and on real robots.
